lockFileMaintenance.description: Bun's own minimumReleaseAge holds the regenerated lockfile to 7 days; Renovate can't date it

customManagers.description: Bun version defaults in Dockerfiles, which follow packageManager

packageRules.description: The bun manager reads no locked versions, so only a range bump surfaces in-range updates
Majors need migration work, so each waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
Bun follows the release nixpkgs-unstable ships
Repology has no release dates, so nixpkgs packaging is the delay instead of the release age
Bun base images take their tag from ARG BUN_VERSION, which follows packageManager above
Drizzle publishes commit snapshots such as 1.0.0-rc.5-ab785fc; allow only releases and numbered release candidates
Our own packages skip the release age and the weekly schedule, so a code-standards release reaches consumers at the next Renovate run; consumers also list them in bunfig's minimumReleaseAgeExcludes
Callers pin the shared workflows by commit; Renovate moves the pin to the newest commit on main, which carries no release date
Git refs and runner labels carry no release dates and would otherwise wait forever
Pinning a digest adds no new code
Registries such as gcr.io publish no release dates; age images where a date exists
